admission.justification: A hand-edited closeout cell or older producer could otherwise publish an unjudged pair to the parent.

applicability: Leaf integration preview and apply before any ref publication.
conditions: The closeout cell supplies the exact pair and the current parent-memory tip is a validator base.
exclusions: Broad MQC, coherence, test and independent-review campaigns are not run here.
statement: worktree_integrate on a leaf judges the closeout cells' pair once more before any ref moves, preview and apply; refusals carry knowledge-gate-refused with every finding.
